conditions.label: Consumption tax payer
conditions.description: A taxable business for consumption tax (for example above the sales threshold in the base period, or by choice).

conditions.label: Pays salaries
conditions.description: Withholds income tax from salaries, including directors' pay.

conditions.label: Twice-yearly withholding payments
conditions.description: Approved for the special rule (納期の特例) for small payers.

profileFields.label: Trade name (商号)
profileFields.description: The company name in the commercial register, including 株式会社 or 合同会社.

profileFields.label: Corporate number (法人番号)
profileFields.description: The 13-digit number assigned to the company.

profileFields.label: Head office (本店)
profileFields.description: The head office address in the register.

profileFields.label: Business purposes (目的)
profileFields.description: The purposes in the articles of incorporation.

profileFields.label: Registry office (Legal Affairs Bureau)
profileFields.description: The Legal Affairs Bureau that keeps the registration.

setupSteps.title: Prepare the articles of incorporation
setupSteps.description: The members prepare the articles; a GK's articles do not need a notary's certification.

setupSteps.title: Pay in the contributions
setupSteps.description: The members pay in their contributions before the registration.

setupSteps.title: Apply for registration of establishment
setupSteps.description: The person who will represent the company applies at the Legal Affairs Bureau of the head office, in writing or online, with the articles and the members' consent. Applications are in Japanese.

setupSteps.title: Notify the tax office of the incorporation
setupSteps.description: Submit the corporation establishment notification (法人設立届出書) with a copy of the articles within two months of the registration date, by e-Tax or on paper.

setupSteps.title: Notify the prefecture and the municipality
setupSteps.description: Local governments also need an establishment notification. Check their forms and deadlines.

setupSteps.title: Decide on the blue return (青色申告)
setupSteps.description: Approval for the blue return is applied for with the tax office; the forms in No.5100 list the deadline.

setupSteps.title: Open a corporate bank account
setupSteps.description: Banks ask for the registration certificate and the company seal.

setupSteps.title: Pay the registration and license tax
setupSteps.description: 7/1,000 of the stated capital, with a minimum of 60,000 yen per application.

typicalCost.note: The minimum; 7/1,000 of the stated capital if that is more.

obligations.title: Corporate tax final return
obligations.description: File within two months after the business year ends. The articles can allow an extension; local tax returns follow similar dates.

obligations.title: Local corporate taxes (prefecture and municipality)
obligations.description: Corporate inhabitant tax and enterprise tax are filed with the prefecture and the municipality. Check the dates with them.

obligations.title: Consumption tax final return
obligations.description: File and pay within two months after the taxable period ends (three months with the extension, where it applies).

obligations.title: Pay withheld income tax
obligations.description: Pay the income tax withheld from salaries by the 10th of the month after payment. Small payers can get the special rule with two payments a year instead.

obligations.title: Pay withheld income tax, January to June
obligations.description: Under the special rule, tax withheld from January to June is paid by 10 July.

obligations.title: Pay withheld income tax, July to December
obligations.description: Under the special rule, tax withheld from July to December is paid by 20 January of the next year.

obligations.title: Register changes
obligations.description: Changes to registered matters (officers, head office, purposes, capital) are registered with the Legal Affairs Bureau. Check the deadline for each change.
